description: Defines a template class 'flat_map' implementing a sorted associative container with custom iterators, supporting insertion, deletion, lookup, and sorting of key-value pairs.

classes.name: flat_map
classes.description: A sorted associative container similar to std::map but backed by vectors, with custom iterator support.

classes.name: flat_map::iter_impl
classes.description: Custom iterator implementation for flat_map, supporting random access iteration over key-value pairs.

methods.name: operator[]
methods.description: Access or insert element by key, returning reference to mapped value.

methods.name: find
methods.description: Find element by key, returning iterator to element or end() if not found.

methods.name: insert
methods.description: Insert key-value pair into the map.

methods.name: erase
methods.description: Remove element by iterator or key.

methods.name: emplace
methods.description: Construct and insert element in place.

methods.name: sort_and_rem_duplicates
methods.description: Sorts the internal containers and removes duplicate keys.
